name: Hold'em Night
hook: Texas hold'em with friends. Play chips only.
how: Two cards each, five shared on the board: bet, call, raise or fold, and the best five-card hand takes the pot (side pots when someone is all-in). Chips are play chips only, with no real money and nothing to buy; run out and you just buy back in.
controls: Click or tap Fold, Check/Call or Raise; drag the slider to size a raise (keys F, C, R)
uses: Your two cards are sealed so only you can read them (the host deals, so it can too).
The host's browser shuffles, deals, runs the betting and pays the pots; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats, play by hand strength and sometimes bluff; a friend who joins takes a bot's seat next hand.
The biggest pot each player has won.
ideas: Make the blinds go up every 10 hands
Add a chat bubble so players can trash-talk
Turn it into a space casino with neon chips
